sql: SELECT ownership, count(*) n, round(avg(completion_rate_4yr),3) c4, round(median(median_debt_noncompleters),0) med_nc_debt, round(median(median_debt_completers),0) med_c_debt FROM edu.college_scorecard WHERE state='TX' AND year=(SELECT max(year) FROM edu.college_scorecard WHERE median_debt_noncompleters IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY ownership
